main_body: Round leafy canopy (two lobes) on a short brown trunk, with a small grass patch at the base
top_band: Mid-to-light green canopy dome at rows ~1-14 with lighter highlights. It is a rounded volume with no flat top band; a dark under-shadow runs at rows ~16-18 above the lower lobe.
evidence: This is an organic tree. The canopy is a domed mass with a lit upper area, a dark underside shadow, and a lower lobe, plus a trunk below. It reads as a volume seen from above and the front, not a flat elevation. No flat horizontal surface or receding side face is expected for this kind. The silhouette and trunk are acceptable for an organic object.

style.evidence: The canopy has about 5 greens and a dark-green outline, which is the right kind of tinted outline. The silhouette is a smooth blob with no leaf-clump scallops. The interior shading is noisy blotches that do not read as individual leaf clusters, unlike the references' crisp clumps with per-clump highlights. The trunk is thin, flat and has few colours, with no roots or bark detail, and the grass base is simple. Overall it looks thinner and less crafted than the references.
